proposal: Give the research grader the mechanical coherence assert it has asked for across 6+ runs: a soft, counted validate-events.js warning that fires when an event's human-facing `summary` DESIGNATES a Norwegian viewing channel the structured `streaming[]` does NOT carry. This is the exact class of self-contradiction the grader keeps catching by hand — the Toppidrettsveka hard-fail (streaming[]=NRK, prose «Vises på VG+ Sport») and the Brann/Lillestrøm returlegg wrong-channel bug that survived six 'fixed' notes. The check parses ONLY the designated-viewing clause (the fragment after a 'Norsk visning:' / 'Vises på' / 'Vises gratis på' marker, up to the next sentence break), so it fires precisely and does NOT false-fire on the 'primary + secondary/contrast channel' lines that a naive any-channel-in-prose scan trips over (measured: naive = 13/90 false positives on live data; clause-scoped = 2/90, both genuine Eurosport co-channel omissions). Includes a negation guard ('…ikke på TV 2' is not a designation). Counted as a WARNING (the WP-246/WP-242 pattern) — surfaced to the agent live via the PostToolUse validate-after-write hook and printed by the CLI, never a build-breaking error. Sharpens an existing script (validate-events.js); adds no machinery; touches no protected path.
evidence: docs/data/research-log.json (2026-08-24 grader block) — VEDVARENDE, explicitly '(improve-mandat, IKKE research, −10)': 'coherence-test som asserter events.json streaming[]-konsistens er fortsatt ikke bygd — flagget i 6+ kjøringer på rad (Brann/Lillestrøm-display-bug overlevde seks «fikset»-notater). Nettopp klassen mekanisk assert som ville fanget Toppidrettsveka-mismatchen. Gjentas for improve.' The grader docks the score every run this remains unbuilt.

Same run's quality.failures[0]: the grader had to hand-fix a HARD FAIL #6 (summary↔streaming self-contradiction) on THREE Toppidrettsveka events (streaming[] said NRK, summary prose said «Vises på VG+ Sport (VGTV) — krever abonnement») — an expensive LLM pass doing what a deterministic assert should own.
git commit 8fcc3ea75 'research-agent: fix wrong streaming channel (Brann/Lillestrøm returlegg -> VG+ Sport)' — the second cited instance of the same class reaching production.

Reproduced on the live events.json: the clause-scoped check flags exactly 2/90 events (Vuelta + Bretagne Classic, both 'HBO Max (Sport)/Eurosport' in prose but only HBO Max in streaming[]) — genuine co-channel omissions, 0 errors, pipeline unaffected. The now-fixed Toppidrettsveka events (NRK + VG+ Sport in both prose and streaming[]) correctly do NOT flag; the pre-fix shape does.

npm test: 1382 passed (81 files), up from 1376 — 6 new targeted tests in tests/validate-events.test.js: Toppidrettsveka-class flag, fixed-Toppidrettsveka pass, secondary-channel-outside-clause pass, empty-streaming[] pass (that is the separate streaming-missing gap), negation guard, and the Eurosport co-channel case.
notes: Home choice: validate-events.js, not a standalone tests/ file, because that script runs LIVE after every research/verify write via the .claude PostToolUse validate-after-write hook — so the agent gets the mechanical signal the moment it writes a contradicting summary, AND the pure logic (summaryChannelMismatches) is unit-tested in CI. Mirrors exactly how streamingMissing / streamingLandingOnly / timeBasisWeak / channelBasisWeak already work.

Expected effect: the grader stops spending a hard-fail slot + a bounded-revision pass on summary↔streaming contradictions; research/verify see the mismatch count immediately and reconcile prose vs streaming[] (e.g. add Eurosport to the two cycling events' streaming[], or drop it from the prose).

How we'll know it worked: research-log grader.failures stops carrying the 'coherence-test … ikke bygd (−10)' line, and summary↔streaming hard-fails stop recurring; the live warning count trends to 0 as the two cycling co-channel omissions get reconciled.

Scope guard: WARNING only (errors unchanged at 0 on live data), so build-events.js's WP-94 degrade gate is untouched and no existing event is felled. Clause-scoped + negation-guarded to keep false positives near zero.
